captions.GeometryCaseCaption: Primary inventory-matched pair \texttt{source-\allowbreak{}v23-\allowbreak{}10037-\allowbreak{}matched-\allowbreak{}0/\allowbreak{}geometry/\allowbreak{}future-\allowbreak{}00} from held-out source 10037 in the initial isometric view. Both contexts use 63 source pieces (47 fixed); the exact part-number/color multiset, registered poses, start, target, rack, work, and plan match. After 2 shared legal operations, the exact labels are context 1: first conflict at operation 3; context 2: all legal. Only subsets of original fixed instances change. These publication views omit ID overlays; answers are evaluator annotations. Pixel distinction is not perceptual answerability.
captions.RepairCaseCaption: Certified lag-5 repair, \texttt{source-\allowbreak{}10036-\allowbreak{}35/\allowbreak{}repair-\allowbreak{}lag-\allowbreak{}5}, source 10036. A: the pre-error checkpoint defines the optimal corridor. B: an error and 5 further operations leave it. The last history action is \texttt{attach P013}. Undoing it first requires 9 operations to repair; the optimum takes 7, starting with \texttt{detach P002}. C: a nonterminal corridor state is restored. These are oracle replay frames, not model reasoning or a model success; exact source instances and actions are archived.
captions.ResourceCaseCaption: Exact oracle replay of \texttt{roadster-\allowbreak{}body-\allowbreak{}05} from source 31027. The displayed operations are 0, 14, 28, 42; the certified optimum is 42 operations. This is a software witness, not a model trajectory.
